The credibility of the evidence in the text is mixed. The written confession itself is direct evidence, but its admissibility is contested by the defense's claim of duress. The supporting evidence for this claim—phone records showing repeated calls from unknown sources—is relevant and potentially credible, as it provides a factual basis for the allegation of coercion. However, the records alone do not prove the content of the calls or the intent of the callers, so while relevant, they may not be sufficient on their own to invalidate the confession without further corroboration.

The name of the planet humans live on is Earth.
